declarations.rationale: Premises, showrooms and geographic institutional presence dominate the organization-to-street arguments.
Gallery/salesroom/showroom and house location dominate; writing/editorial affiliation and political leadership remain separate.
Artistic works/collections/releases reviewed in DVD medium form the largest family, separate from office/datelined reporting and seats.
Explicit joint voting and joining-with form a coherent common-action family. Mere numerical superiority remains separate.
Fire/dismiss has five rows exceeding four replace rows; person selecting/dismissing someone does not imply succeeding them.
Destination move and relocate paths dominate, with physical stationing, corporate-name fragments and ownership/location as competitors.
Coaching title/action family dominates over membership and legislative veto power. Malformed coach subject paths still require case-local role resolution.
Four explicit policy-toward rows form the highest repeated interpretable family; travel, severing relations and arms sales are distinct.
Destination travel/visit core for Nixon-China is the largest identifiable family, with political work-with and accusation separate; bare make-to remains uncertain.
Victory-over and sporting stop identify the leading completed-opponent-win family; losses, reverse score and event championship remain separate.
Borough-to-president is the leading specific inverse-office family; press-office roles, acquisition and political control remain separate.
Explicit condition/infection/suffering and affected-population subsets dominate; inverse minister and political commentary remain distinct.
Specific manager and manager tenure form the largest title family; ordinary use, legal head, sports winner and spokesperson remain distinct.
Director title paths dominate; economist-only is a separate role.
Political leader family dominates; ordinary senator and national company descriptions alone remain excluded.

The coherent geographic-presence family includes balanced residence, death, remaining and removal-location evidence without one narrower subtype dominating; inverse reporting/spokesperson is distinct. Each row must actually locate affected people.
Public attorney jurisdiction family dominates; private location versus jurisdiction remains a case-local ambiguity, while sporting venue and inverse leader are distinct.
Specific chair title/succession family exceeds head, analysis, corporate acquisition and place descriptors.

Parent approved genuine tie after all rows read: wife2 versus forward president2, with one inverse-president and coach-commitment/meeting/candidacy fragments. All paths singleton, no consistent highest-path tie-break or coherent union.

Residence/live/home/apartment family dominates the geographic-person arguments; population share and sports office are distinct. Dying at home may be residence evidence only when the person/home attachment is clear.

Two-count explicit executive title is the highest individually interpretable path, resolving a weak family tie with two artistic-review paths and scattered inverse presidential context; retain very low dictionary coverage.
Five explicit ethicist/bioethicist rows tie five director-role paths; the two-count specific ethicist paths resolve the tie over singleton director paths. No union with all academic jobs.
Specific county-executive office family dominates; executive-elect and candidacy alone will not establish tenure.
Literal first arguments are cities hosting agency offices; this is the inverse geographic office relation, not corporate parentage by a city.
Museum/site and street-premises family dominates; the full embedded metadata also identifies museum street address, with spokesperson and legal interaction separate.
